request: What are the costs of federal student loan forgiveness programs such as Public Service Loan Forgiveness?

reply.reply:
**Federal student-loan forgiveness entails subsidy, appropriated-program, and administrative costs; PSLF discharged or repaid $36.3 billion during July 1, 2022–June 30, 2023, including Limited PSLF Waiver benefits.**

- CRS reports $36.3 billion in PSLF amounts discharged or repaid from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, including Limited PSLF Waiver recipients. (R43571, PDF p. 42)
- CRS identifies loan subsidy, appropriated program, and administrative costs as three categories associated with these programs. (R43571, PDF p. 31)
- CRS said federal law authorized at least 47 service-contingent loan forgiveness or repayment programs, approximately 30 of which were operational on or after October 1, 2021 or later. (R47837, PDF p. 4)
reply.reasoning: CRS explains the main categories of program costs and reports a period-specific PSLF discharge/repayment amount. The reported PSLF figure is not a comprehensive estimate of all programs’ net federal budget cost.
